title: Aureon OS evidence architecture
summary: A shared evidence core designed to move attributable source material through provenance, accountable human authority and bounded decision outputs across multiple sector applications.

architecture.flow: Source to provenance to human authority to accountable output

layers.label: Attributable sources
layers.public_description: Public repositories, formal research records and clearly identified company material.

layers.label: Provenance and claim state
layers.public_description: Origin, evidence state and interpretation boundaries remain attached to material claims.

layers.label: Accountable human authority
layers.public_description: Material decisions retain a named human gate and a defined scope of authority.

layers.label: Bounded outputs
layers.public_description: Reviewable outputs preserve their source, state, decision boundary and next proof.

disclosure_boundary: This public view presents attributable source routes, research identity and high-level evidence architecture. Supporting diligence is shared only in a qualified, scoped review.
